prediction.calibration_source: FERC/NERC/NRC RE Final Report on the February 2021 Cold Weather Outages in Texas and the South Central United States (November 2021); public.

kill_condition.rule: fail if slope < 0.40 (link too weak to recover the documented coupling shape), fail if slope > 0.95 (over-prediction even above the report's upper bound), fail if slope < 0 (null direction realized — documented direction not recovered)
kill_condition.rationale: The voice claims a positive, bounded coupling whose window is taken from the FERC/NERC report's range of findings on gas-curtailment-to-generation-loss. Any of three falsification outcomes is testable from run output alone: slope below the floor, above the ceiling, or wrong sign. The null direction is named explicitly so its realization is a registry-acceptable null per §3.4, not a hidden disconfirmation. This voice's pass does not constitute a real-grid claim; see PREREGISTRATION §1 honesty bound on coupling magnitudes.
